verdict.rationale: Firebase offers managed databases (Cloud Firestore and Realtime Database) with official client SDKs for realtime sync/offline support and server SDKs (Admin SDK) via Cloud Functions, plus CLI tooling for data interaction; community feedback corroborates real-world use of realtime read/write across client and server. Security Rules further confirm client/server access model. Missing for 10: no direct citation of Admin SDK server-side read/write specifics beyond CLI mention, and no independent benchmark of query completeness given community complaints about query limitations.
